entries.basis: Direct inspection of the publisher PDF text locates B16041/AIT27 in section 2.2 and as the central witness in section 3. Section 4 provides a comparative English translation primarily based on NLI 9467.163 with witness variants. This verifies a publication relationship, not every reading, a standalone bowl-specific translation, or complete digital capture. Existing Montgomery attribution and text absences remain unchanged.
